about: Water names in TX's records that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for TX: TCEQ's Sanitary Sewer Overflows table (data.texas.gov 8kc5-95uk, read 2026-11-07, every report since 2010; the receiving water a report gives, once per report), one row per name and county, with the towns of the operators that reported it (nearest first by reports), the permits and TCEQ segment codes. A name the national list carries only as a GNIS name of another water is kept, with that water in gnis_name_of (Post Oak Creek in Grayson County is not the Red River). Records naming no water and texts that are not a water's name are left out (by_reason). Texas Beach Watch names no water: its stations are placed by their points. Written by scripts/tx_report_water_names.py.
